actions_or_findings.title: IA005-F2-C3 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: concurrent closures can deadlock
actions_or_findings.trigger: A primary order closes while a real follower closure holds that follower's assignment lock and seeks the incident lock.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The primary can hold the incident lock and wait for the follower assignment; the follower can hold that assignment and wait for the incident. MySQL may abort either transaction with 1213. WorkOrderService then returns a generic 500 without retry, so a valid business action fails. The saved contention run held a follower lock without a competing business action; it does not cover this cycle. Transaction rollback protects data, but the concurrency path remains unfinished.
